relations.subject: Erik Haarh
relations.role: teaching assistant in Tibetan language and culture
relations.evidence: After finishing his MA degree in 1955 he was employed by Copenhagen University as a teaching assistant in Tibetan language and culture.

relations.subject: Erik Haarh
relations.evidence: In 1956 he was employed as a librarian at the Royal Danish Library in their Oriental Department

relations.subject: Erik Haarh
relations.evidence: in 1962 became the head of the department.

relations.subject: Erik Haarh
relations.evidence: Starting in 1969 he became head of the History/Religion Department at Aarhus University.

relations.subject: Erik Haarh
relations.role: professor in the Faculty of Theology
relations.evidence: Beginning in 1983 Haarh became a professor in the Faculty of Theology. He died on 1 December 1993
